resolution: Fixed the CompileAssetDialog crash by moving the extracted LCField/LCStepper controls into a shared studiokit dialogControls module, importing them in CompileAssetDialog, and wiring the other extracted dialogs that had the same latent undefined helper issue. Verified hmsc-int bundles through scripts/cart-bundle.js and tools/tsc-check hmsc-int passes.
